description: This file defines a final class PoliciesResourceType which contains constant String fields representing different resource types ('policy', 'thing', 'message') and static methods for creating ResourceKey objects associated with these types, using a resource path. The class acts as a utility for managing policy resource types within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PoliciesResourceType
classes.description: A utility class containing constants and static methods for creating ResourceKey objects for different policy resource types.

methods.name: policyResource
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey for a policy resource with the given resource path.

methods.name: thingResource
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey for a thing resource with the given resource path.

methods.name: messageResource
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey for a message resource with the given resource path.
